title: Prerequisites
raw_text:
9/29/26, 10:19 AM
You can wait until a disconnection document is released in your workflow before beginning the actual disconnection process.

Prerequisites

In order to use the Disconnection document release function, set the release requirement to active in the corresponding
disconnection processing variant.

Features

The Disconnection document release function sets the corresponding status in the disconnection document and triggers the
accompanying event for the workflow system.

Activities
The disconnection documents are released individually. The release can also be defined as a workflow step.

The release and completion of a disconnection document exist as individual disconnection activities in the disconnection
document.

Disconnection Order Generation

Use

This function is used to create disconnection orders. A disconnection order is an object that contains the disconnection details for
devices that are to be disconnected.

Remote Disconnections in an Advanced Metering Infrastructure Environment

If you are working in an advanced metering infrastructure (AMI) environment, you can configure the disconnection order for the
remote disconnection of AMI devices (such as smart meters or advanced meters). For more information, see Advanced Metering
Infrastructure .

Integration

Generating Customer Notifications

In the disconnection order, you need to indicate whether a CRM agent is required to contact the corresponding customer before a
service agent (or the system — in the case of remote disconnections) carries out the actual device disconnection. The process of
contacting a customer for this purpose is called notification and the requirement for notification is based on legal requirements or
on intra-enterprise guidelines.

e If notification is required, the system generates a notification work item . The CRM agent assigned to this work item must
contact the customer, set an agreed date and close the work item before the disconnection order can be processed further.

e If notification is not required, or if the notification work item is closed, you can continue processing the disconnection order.

Creating and Managing Work Items and Worklists for Customer Notifications
